label: War Banners
description: Standards and their wind — cloth physics, heraldry, and what a banner's state says about the fight around it.

items.name: torn-lion
items.text: a quartered lion banner ripped to streamers by arrow-strikes, every strip still pulling the same direction from a bowing pole

items.name: pennon-forest
items.text: a forest of swallow-tailed pennons above the lance ranks, hundreds of small flags rolling in sequence as one gust combs down the line

items.name: raven-standard
items.text: a black raven standard on a tar-dark pole, the bird sewn wings-spread so that every gust makes it fly

items.name: sunburst-gold
items.text: a cloth-of-gold sunburst banner, bullion thread throwing hard glints with every ripple, readable from the far ridge

items.name: dragon-windsock
items.text: a sewn dragon windsock standard, wind pouring through its bronze jaw and filling the silk body until it writhes like a living thing

items.name: burning-banner
items.text: a standard alight along its top edge, flame eating downwind through the heraldry, embers streaming leeward over the ranks

items.name: planted-fallen
items.text: a fallen banner planted at a hard angle in the mud, cloth soaked heavy and stirring only at the corners, a rallying point with nobody yet around it

items.name: white-hart
items.text: a white hart banner on a moss-green field, the heavy cloth bellying and snapping in slow deep waves above the spear-points

items.name: horsehair-tug
items.text: a horsehair tug standard, black and white tails streaming horizontal from a gilded disc, hissing at every gust

items.name: prayer-streamers
items.text: spear-shafts down the whole line tied with script-inked prayer streamers, hundreds of thin cloth strips all pointing the wind's way
